impostazioni.dialogs.mail_info_descripti:
Kondomanager uses a hybrid sending engine. You can choose to use the server default configuration (Env) or configure your own personal SMTP server (Database).

Activate the switch below only if you have custom SMTP credentials (e.g., Gmail, Sendgrid, SMTP2Go) and cannot modify the .env file.

impostazioni.dialogs.cron_info_descripti:
Kondomanager performs scheduled background tasks (e.g., generating installments, sending emails).

Normally, the server handles this autonomously. Enable this option ONLY if you are on Shared Hosting that does not allow configuring the system "Crontab" via terminal.
